featured_reviews.name: chanchal rawal
featured_reviews.review_text: There are things you plan and then there are things destiny plans for you.On the recommendation of a neighbour, during fourth month of my pregnancy, I went to Dr Joglekar with the mindset of visiting a few more times for routine check-ups till seventh month, after which I was planning to go back to my hometown, Udaipur for delivery. But destiny had other plans for me. It was all good till 5.5 month, I had a normal healthy routine involving office and household chores, yoga and after dinner walk. One day I started feeling pain in pelvic region, and we visited the doctor. Sonography was recommended during which we came to know baby is shifting towards the lower end of uterus so I need to take full rest.After 3 days, I had heavy bleeding at 11:30 pm. We rushed to the hospital, the staff was very supportive and immediately I was admitted. I was kept under observation till morning and then discharged with new set of medicines and was prescribed full bed rest. This situation carried on from sixth to ninth month with intermittent bleeding issues, multiple sonographies, time to time analysis of how can we keep things stable and carry on as long as possible. Dr Joglekar explained us all the complications and did everything under his control to have a safe delivery. Till ninth month I had bleeding issues but with medicines, rest and timely care I was able to carry on till last stage. My due date was 28 november but on 11 november, the sonography detected lack of amniotic fluid aroud the baby.So I was admitted on 12th November where I was given pain inducing injections and we tried our level best for normal delivery. And the result was a beautiful baby girl born on the same day without any operation.I whole heartedly thank Dr Joglekar and entire staff for the utmost care and positive attitude they maintained throughout my journey. Thank you Dr Joglekar!
